title: A Escarpment for the Passage
author: Vesper Ravensworth
blurb: Freya Joubert, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
